forum.title: STlink Firmware Update
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@HC1994

Let me thank you for posting and welcome to the ST Community.

I recommend that you click on Open in update mode then click on Upgrade.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/05e4aa50-93ea-4bb1-bd11-4ee6d4c1550f.png)

Thanks.

Mahmoud
